intro_en: A single point of coordination for studio, location and campaign production — bringing together the people, equipment and workflow required by the brief.
intro_fa: یک نقطه هماهنگی برای تولید استودیویی، لوکیشن و کمپین؛ با گردآوری عوامل، تجهیزات و روند اجرایی متناسب با سفارش.
details_en: Studio and location sourcing and booking
Camera operators, directors and production assistants
Lighting, sound, teleprompter and technical crew coordination
Studio interviews, presenter-led explainers and panel formats
Corporate, institutional, campaign and event films
Livestream and remote interview setup coordination
Video editing, graphics, voice-over and subtitles
Production schedules, call sheets and final delivery management

delivery_en: A coordinated production team and complete workflow, from concept and pre-production to filming, editing, quality control and final assets for broadcast, web and social platforms.
